question_from_llm: Can the number of family/friends robbed in the last 5 years (vlh09a) explain the household's total times being robbed (house/business/parcel) since 2005 (vlh18a)?
natural_question_arisen_from_code: Using the ii_vlh table, what relationship exists between X = vlh09a (number of family/friends who have been robbed of a house/business) and Y = vlh18a (total times a household’s house/business/parcel has been entered/robbed since 2005)? Does vlh09a help explain vlh18a? Fit a simple linear regression of vlh18a on vlh09a (dropping rows with missing values) and report the coefficient, intercept, R², and correlation.
